mission: Audit-only (FROZEN) — no env flag bypass + composition_snapshot tamper-proof + branch-scoped pricing
verdict: GREEN — no bypass in Pricing namespace, configuration boundary documented, end-to-end SSOT proof exists

findings.evidence_result: ZERO matches across all 7 files in app/Services/Pricing/.
findings.observation: PricingService and its peers do NOT consume `env()` directly. The only environment-driven booleans (`pricing.use_ssot_service`, `pricing.tax_inclusive_prices`) are accessed via `config(...)` from config/pricing.php at runtime. This is correct Laravel discipline — config layer is cache-stable in production (php artisan config:cache) whereas direct env() is not.

The bypass flag `config('pricing.use_ssot_service')` is consumed OUTSIDE the Pricing namespace by OrderService (3 sites) and FrontendOrderService (2 sites). Each site reads `true` by default and only the legacy branch is gated by the flag. This is a configuration boundary, not a Pricing-namespace violation. Sentinel `PricingSsotFlagProductionStableSentinelTest` (5 tests) pins the flag to `true` across `config/pricing.php`, `.env.example`, `.env.testing`, `.github/workflows/phpunit.yml`, `.github/workflows/playwright.yml`. Any drift triggers CI failure.

findings.evidence_result: ZERO offenders in app/ source (sentinel itself in tests/ deliberately documents the forbidden patterns).
findings.observation: composition_snapshot is written via INSERT only. Application-layer immutability invariant is rigorously enforced. NO update/save/assign call site exists in app/. The Zone5 sentinel test grep-asserts this on every CI run.

No DB-level BEFORE UPDATE trigger on order_items.composition_snapshot (the analogous TRIGGER protection exists on audit_logs + z_reports per CLAUDE.md §8). Application-layer is the only line of defense today. Wave 1 (NF525 fiscal audit) flagged this as P3 / V1.1 backlog. Acceptable for V1 — the Zone5 sentinel + application grep + sentinel CI test cover the risk surface.

Item price is RE-READ from DB (`$dbItem->price` from Item::query()->select('id','price','tax_id')) at line 134. The frontend `price` field is never accessed in the line-cost computation. PR01 sentinel + PosPricingSsotProofTest end-to-end prove that forged client `price: 0.01` is overwritten by the DB price. Anti-forgery contract intact.

When `enforceCrossItemGuards=true` (default true across all 4 factories), the service rejects requests where a variation/extra/addon ID does not belong to the parent item_id. Throws 422 with explicit message. Prevents cross-item ID injection attacks (e.g. submitting a cheap variation under an expensive item).

Each variation/extra/addon is checked for Status::ACTIVE AND `isVisibleOn($surface)` where surface ∈ {pos, kiosk, web}. Items hidden on POS cannot be smuggled into a kiosk order via direct ID. Defense in depth against catalog surface-leak.

Manual discount only applies when `context in ['pos','table']`. PricingRequest::forKiosk and ::forWeb hardcode `manualDiscountRequest=0.0`, so even if a payload tries to inject manual_discount via web/kiosk surfaces, the factory layer rejects it. Two-layer defense.

Coupon discount is resolved via CouponService::resolveCouponById which performs full validation (active, within window, customer match, min order, etc.). Discount amount is computed server-side. No frontend-supplied discount value is accepted.

Kiosk loyalty redemption caps `maxDiscount = min(requestedDiscount, realSubtotal)`. Points are computed from rate (config). Lock + ledger debit happens in FrontendOrderService (not here) — DiscountCalculator returns the contract (discount + points) without touching DB. Single responsibility preserved.
menuRoleAdjustedAddonPrice rejects non-finite or negative ratios (defaults to 1.0). Unknown menu_* roles default to 1.0 (full price). No way to coerce a negative price or NaN into the line total.

ssot_invariants_status.use_ssot_service_flag_production_stable: PASS (5 sentinels pin config + 2 env templates + 2 CI workflows)
